easyPrerequisites: It is your precombat main phase.
description:
Activate Goblin Firestarter by sacrificing it.
When Goblin Firestarter dies, Mortuary and Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Goblin Firestarter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Goblin Firestarter ability.
Cast Goblin Firestarter from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.name: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel
